events.title: Use the time budget, not a step cap
events.hypothesis: Hypothesis: Runs end with "returned" after exactly 10 model calls while the model is still working, using only 21-62 s of 180 s (all four failed traces); pip installs also hit the 10 s command timeout repeatedly.

 SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are an AI agent that solves tasks in a Linux terminal.
 Use the bash tool to run commands. When the task is complete, reply with a short summary."""
 
-MAX_STEPS = 10

events.title: Verify requirements before finishing
events.hypothesis: Hypothesis: Four of five traces end with a confident text answer with time left and no check against the task's requirements, and the answers were wrong (count-dataset-tokens, sparql-university, break-filter-js-from-html, bn-fit-modify).

--- agent.py (c001)
+++ agent.py (c002)
@@ -16,6 +16,10 @@
 MAX_STEPS = 60  # a safety net: the real limit is the time budget
 MIN_TIME_LEFT_S = 8  # stop calling the model when less time than this remains
 MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1000
+CHECK_PROMPT = ("Before finishing, re-read the task. List every requirement (file paths, formats, exact values, constraints). "
+                "Verify each one with a command that shows real output, not from memory, and fix anything that is wrong. "
+                "If everything is verified, reply with a short summary.")
+MIN_TIME_TO_CHECK_S = 30  # only ask for a check when there is time to act on it
 MAX_TASK_CHARS = 1000  # long task texts waste context
 COMMAND_TIMEOUT_S = 90  # upper bound; each command also gets at most the time left
 # After every command, kill whatever it left running, so no stray program survives into the next step.
@@ -52,6 +56,7 @@
         {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
         {"role": "user", "content": task[:MAX_TASK_CHARS]},
     ]
+    checked = False
     for step in range(MAX_STEPS):
         if env.time_left() < MIN_TIME_LEFT_S:
             return
@@ -59,7 +64,11 @@
         messages.append(reply)
         tool_calls = reply.get("tool_calls") or []
         if not tool_calls:
-            return  # the model answered in text: we are done
+            if checked or env.time_left() < MIN_TIME_TO_CHECK_S:
+                return  # the model answered in text: we are done
+            checked = True  # first answer: make the model verify its work once
+            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": CHECK_PROMPT})
+            continue
         for call in tool_calls:
             content = run_tool_call(call, env)
             messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call["id"], "content": content})
